notes: Checked against Book 7535 Page 1128, PDF page 2 (Schedule C, File No. ITA7722, Revised 6/11/04), at 220 dpi: the legal description, all four courses and deed_info match the print; expected_pob now includes the printed 'said point being ... 81.33 feet' clause. This deed prints 22 minutes 34 seconds, 20.01 feet and 61 degrees 11 minutes 34 seconds; the later deed for the same lot (7609-137) prints 35 seconds, 20.02 feet and 33 seconds. Legal description transcribed verbatim from Schedule C (File No. ITA7722, revised 6/11/04), Book 7535 Page 1128, PDF page 2; the deed prints 'Back Associates' for the surveyor and opens course (1) 'Along said division line' although it runs along the Northeasterly line of Lot 10. Lot 12.10 is an interior lot in Willits Court. First sold to Dorothy O'Donnell, who resold it the same year (deed 7609-137). The resurvey for the resale used slightly different bearing seconds (33"/35" vs 34").
